n: Study tools by kennedyraju55 (Ollama and Gemma 3)
t: Five free Python study tools that run on a local model through Ollama.
steps: Find the tool repositories by kennedyraju55 on GitHub.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Install Ollama and pull the Gemma model.
Clone one tool repository and install its requirements.
Run the Streamlit app and test it with a sample chapter.
Go offline and confirm the tool still works.
